headline: Helium Health Secures $2.5 Million Google.org Grant for AI Healthcare
summary: Nigerian health technology company Helium Health secured a $2.5 million grant from Google.org to deploy artificial intelligence solutions aimed at improving maternal healthcare delivery.
why: Grant funding supports early-stage technology deployment and strategic expansion for specialized healthcare tech platforms in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Helium Health
impacts.why: Grant funding directly provides non-dilutive capital for operational development.
